valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E Core EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Elevated catastrophe losses, faster commercial lines pricing moderation, and lower reserve releases push combined ratio above 92%

base.driver: Underlying combined ratio holds near 85%-86% and after-tax net investment income remains durable above $3.6B, supporting normalized FY2027E earnings

bull.driver: Benign catastrophe activity, disciplined commercial and personal rate retention, and continued share buybacks lift FY2027E EPS toward the top of Street estimates

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $31.25 the $403.23 close implies 12.90x; the published Street consensus target (~$376.63-$384.08) implies 12.05x-12.29x at base EPS or $28.97-$29.54 EPS at 13.0x
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $31.25 (7.7 pp)
valuation.watch_metric: Consolidated underlying combined ratio (vs. 85%-86% target range) and after-tax net investment income

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on October 16, 2026 (Core EPS $9.18, consolidated combined ratio 86.8%), all six tracked analysts raised their price targets, with Roth MKM ($460) and Truist ($435) maintaining Buy ratings while KBW ($382), J.P. Morgan ($379), Mizuho ($373), and Morgan Stanley ($350) stayed Neutral/Underweight. The Street consensus target (~$376.63-$384.08) sits roughly 5%-7% below the $403.23 close, reflecting caution on valuation after the stock's rally and expected EPS normalization from ~$36+ in FY2026 to ~$31.11 in FY2027. Our base case ($406.25, +0.7% upside) is slightly above consensus, assuming a 13.0x multiple on $31.25 FY2027E EPS.
